wiki.title: Gretchen Bulova
wiki.extract: Gretchen Marie Bulova (née Reimer) is an American museum director and politician serving as a member of the Virginia House of Delegates from the 11th district since winning a 2026 special election. She is a member of the Democratic Party and succeeded her husband, David, who was appointed Virginia Secretary of Natural Resources. She has served as director of the Office of Historic Alexandria since January 2019.
